text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Today is a joint dance lesson with 
Twin Turbo. Heading to the park where we 
agreed to meet—"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: —It's startiiing~! With Machitan~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Master Turbo's...!

text_block_list.name: Machitan & Turbo
text_block_list.text: Blazing Fast & Passionate! Dance Lesson~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~ Nice to meet you, Turbo! By the 
way, why did we meet up at the park today?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh-heh... Well, there's a deeeep 
reason for that!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
First of all... it's spacious and easy to 
dance in! Plus, the sun feels amazing!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, I see! So, what kind of training 
should we do?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Geez... I'm gonna step like crazy! And 
then... ride the rhythm like crazy!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Got it! Then, let's step like crazy and 
really get into the groove~!

text_block_list.name: Machitan & Turbo
text_block_list.text: Daa-daa, da-daa-daa...♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...The point of doing this together is a 
mystery, but they look like they're having 
fun, so why not? As I quietly watched on—"

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Huh~? Look, it's Big Sis Machitan and 
Master Turbo. What'cha doing~?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hello. Right now, big sis and the 
others are practicing their dancing.

text_block_list.name: Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Sounds fun! Hey, hey! We wanna join in 
too!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay~. Then let's all sing and dance 
together~♪

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, it got so lively! Alright, since 
we're all here, let's try a new training 
routine!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm. Let's do it, let's do it! But what 
kind should we go with...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Assistant Trainer Guy! What do you think 
is best to do here?!
choice_data_list: What about combining play and dance?
Improving dance skills by teaching others!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Assistant Trainer Lady! What do you think 
is best to do here?!
choice_data_list: What about combining play and dance?
Improving dance skills by teaching others!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I see! So the idea is to learn the dance 
naturally while having fun!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Then... everyone! Let's play step tag~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Just like this, you dodge and chase using 
only steps! How's that sound~? Who wants 
to try~!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: I'll do it, I'll do it~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll be 'it'! Everyone keep to the 
rhythm and run away, okay!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
All right! Everyone, run away from 
Machitan~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, through playing with the children, 
Matikane Tannhauser and the others were 
able to practice their dance steps to 
their hearts' content.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see... If that's the case, the 
very first thing we must do is... change 
the title of the lesson!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: With Machitan~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Master Turbo's...!

text_block_list.name: Machitan & Turbo
text_block_list.text: Exciting! Good Kids' Dance Class~!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Yaaaay!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It ended up feeling like an educational TV 
program... but through teaching, it seemed 
she was able to grasp the knack for 
dancing.
